question: Which among the following state lies in the south of the Great Indian Desert?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Great Indian Desert**, also known as the **Thar Desert**, lies primarily in the northwestern part of India, spanning the state of Rajasthan and extending into parts of Gujarat, Haryana, and Punjab.
 
• **Gujarat** is located to the **southwest of Rajasthan**, making it the state situated to the south of the Great Indian Desert. *Hence, Gujarat is the correct answer.*
 
• **Madhya Pradesh:** This state lies to the southeast of Rajasthan but does not directly border the Great Indian Desert. Therefore, it is not the correct answer.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:** Located in north-central India, Uttar Pradesh is situated to the east of Rajasthan and does not lie in the south of the Great Indian Desert. Hence, it is incorrect.
 
• **Haryana:** This state lies to the northeast of Rajasthan and is not located in the south of the Great Indian Desert. Therefore, it is also incorrect.
 
• The geographical location of Gujarat in close proximity to the Great Indian Desert justifies why it is the state in the south of the desert. *Hence, Gujarat is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Great Indian Desert (Thar Desert):**

 
 
• The **Thar Desert** is the 17th largest desert in the world and the 9th largest subtropical desert. It covers an area of approximately **200,000 square kilometers**.
 
• The desert is characterized by arid conditions, sand dunes, and a hot climate. Its boundaries extend across **Rajasthan**, parts of **Gujarat**, and some regions of **Punjab and Haryana**.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat:**
 
 
• Located in western India, Gujarat is bordered by Rajasthan to the north, Maharashtra to the south, and the Arabian Sea to the west.
 
• The Rann of Kutch, a part of Gujarat, forms the southern boundary of the Great Indian Desert.
 
• The state is renowned for its **cultural heritage**, historic trade routes, and industrial development.
 
 
 
• **Other States Mentioned:**
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh:** Known as the "Heart of India," it lies in central India and does not touch the Great Indian Desert.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:** A populous state in northern India, it is geographically far from the Great Indian Desert.
 
• **Haryana:** Located in northern India, it shares a border with Rajasthan but is to the northeast of the Great Indian Desert.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Geographical Importance:**

 
 
• The **Thar Desert** plays a significant role in influencing the climate, agriculture, and way of life in the regions it spans.
 
• **Rajasthan** hosts the majority of the desert, while Gujarat has the **southern extension** in the form of the Rann of Kutch.
 
 
 
• **Climatic Conditions:**
 
 
• The desert experiences extreme temperatures, with summer temperatures reaching as high as **50°C** and winter temperatures dropping to below **0°C**.
 
• **Rainfall:** The region receives scanty rainfall, typically less than **250 mm annually**, making it arid and dry.
